Dialogs.Dialog: (Oh, right, today is April Fools' Day.)
(Alright, I'll just go with something light for now.)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Actually, ●, I'm thinking of quitting my job at Dexee's.
(...Maybe I should've put a bit more thought into it.)
Are you unhappy there？ Sure, the manager is a bit... you know, but everyone is nice. And the pay isn't bad.
Besides... I'm there. Could that be the reason too？
(Well, whatever. I'll clear things up with her later.)
(Right, I need to clear up ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s misunderstanding.)
Ah, there you are. Hey, are you really quitting？
What a waste. You get to wear a cute uniform here.
Stop, stop. You heard that from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, right? Did she say anything else？
Hmm, she seemed kind of angry~, kind of sad~.
I see... Sorry, excuse me for a bit.
Ah, you. You're quitting？ That's a problem, I need to hire someone new.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Listen, about earlier. That was...
Sorry, I have to go back. I'll hear all about it after work, okay？
Yeah... Sorry! That was a lie!
Today is April Fools', after all.
Hehe, you fell for it. Those girls were in on it too, you know？
No, the manager actually believed it. If we don't clear it up, you'll really end up quitting.
I see, sigh... You got me.
Even for a lie, it was too simple. It was obviously made up on the spot.
Hehe, cute. Let's see~ Then, how about an apology for trying to trick me？
Come to think of it, it's Golden Week...
Ah, right, it is. What about it？
For three days from May 3rd to 5th. If you share a loooong kiss with your lover every day...
Your relationship will progress a looot.
(She must mean the one that goes on forever...)
I wonder if we can do it.
The Golden Week kiss. I told you about it before, right？
Jeez, you were doing it that much without even realizing...
But with this, our relationship will progress a looot, right？
(Now that she mentions it, I feel like I've gotten closer to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
If you don't remember, it's no good... The Golden Week kiss.
I was really looking forward to it... Jeez.
(Today the pool opens. It's a joint class with another grade, so maybe with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
Is it... weird after all？ I don't really look good in a school swimsuit...
No! This is totally fine in its own way!
If you say so, I'll believe it. Hehe, see you later.
(I'm looking forward to pool classes from now on!)
(Today the pool opens. It's a joint class with another grade, so maybe with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
What are you looking at？ You think it doesn't suit me anyway, right？
You're so attractive... I was mesmerized.
(I'm looking forward to pool classes from now on!)
(Today the pool opens. It's a joint class with another grade, so maybe with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
Is this kind of thing not your type？
That's not true... um, it is my type.
Hehe, good. Ah, and no looking at anyone else, okay？
(I'm looking forward to pool classes from now on!)
Should I go on a diet after all？
But there are lots of girls with better figures than me, you know？
That's not true. Being thin isn't everything.
Because you can see underwater, right？ Like other girls' swimsuits.
That might be true, but... it's fine. I'm not interested in anyone but ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You know how in swimming classes, the teacher holds the kid's hands and makes them kick their legs？
I kind of want to try it？
You look cool in a swimsuit too...
Eh？ What's with that, all of a sudden.
Huh... did I say that out loud just now？
Jeez, forget it？ Wait, no, you don't have to forget it, but don't think it's weird, okay？
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... I wonder what's wrong, looking around like that.)
What's the matter？ Did something happen？
Hehe. You know, I think you're the coolest after all.
Eh？ You think so, I wonder...
I'm the one saying it, so there's no mistake! Right？
It's a bit of a waste to show it to other girls.
That's not true... Or rather, that's my line.
Hey, they have bamboo decorations at the store, right？
Come to think of it, I forgot. What about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Me too. It's until today, so maybe I'll write something.
Then, let me know if you think of something. Okay？
Yeah, I thought about it... Shouldn't we write about the two of us after all？
That you and I can stay lovers and be happy forever.
I agree with the sentiment, but on the store's bamboo？
That's a bit... No matter how much everyone knows, don't you have any modesty, ●？
Hmph. Are you saying I have no modesty？
(Oops... I need to recover from this.)
Um, I hung a tanzaku. "May the two of us be happy forever"...
I borrowed a stepladder and put it at the very top. You can't see it from below that way. Is this no good？
No, I'm happy. Sorry, you were thinking about it. And yet I...
It's fine. I'm glad you're in a better mood.
(It's over... Coming to school just for this, school days are a pain...)
(But since I'm here, maybe I'll go see ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I was just thinking of going to you.
Yeah, you beat me to it.
I see... Hehe, I'm kind of happy.
(It's over... Coming to school just for this, school days are a pain...)
Entering an upperclassman's classroom makes me a little nervous.
I wanted to see you like that, so I was a little mean.
(It's over... Coming to school just for this, school days are a pain...)
Hehe, I called out to you.
That was actually a little embarrassing.
Right？ Me too, a little. Hehe.
Since I can see you, school days aren't so bad, right？
I see... Then it was worth coming.
Jeez, you're slacking off？ Straighten your back!
Oh, you look a bit down. Vacation blur？
Here, have a candy. Do your best.
I was watching you practice. I hope you can show the results？
I'll watch everything when you're up. Show me your cool side？
Oh, sorry. Then... here, relax, relax.
You know. I was asked to be a substitute for the three-legged race.
Yeah, so. If possible, I want you to be my partner.
Yeah, if I'm your partner, I'll just drag you down though.
That's not true. If you're fine with ●.
Then let's practice matching our pace a bit before the real thing.
It's fine. I'm glad ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ didn't get hurt.
Don't worry about it. ...But why the classroom instead of the nurse's office？
I had a first-aid kit. And besides...
We can be alone, right？ You were cool earlier, you know？
Do you know what day it is today？
I thought so. You know, it's Halloween.
Ah, come to think of it. I didn't realize.
It's not very familiar, right. ...No interest either？
I don't really know what to do, but it might be fun if we could.
I see. Then, it's okay I guess.
(There's nothing on TV I want to watch. What should I do...)
Maybe you're the one being tricked？
That was a surprise attack, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Hehe, I wanted to try it. Sorry for surprising you.
I was certainly surprised but... it was fun. Any plans to do it again？
No! It was embarrassing for me too.
See you, thanks for walking me home.
(I worked hard on the steering committee. I hope it's a success...)
My class is a haunted house. I'm at the reception.
Heh, nice. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ likes horror, so that's good, right？
I actually wanted to be the one scaring people. I meddled too much and got brushed off. Ah geez, it's frustrating!
Phew, I'm going to change. See you later.
(I'm glad the school festival ended without any issues. Now it's just the party.)
Good work. Are you done with your steering committee job？
Then... can I ask you one favor？
？ Yeah, if it's something ● can do.
Then first, let's sneak out of here!
It's quiet... Why are we here？
Don't make me say it. Because we can be alone, right？
...Yeah, that's right. It's kind of like that time.
Well... I couldn't possibly forget what ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ told me here.
If you forget, you won't get off easy, you know？
I won't forget. Probably for the rest of my life.
I see... then I should've chosen a place with more mood. But I didn't have the leeway.
Is that so, I didn't know.
Yeah. And besides... even now, I don't have any leeway, you know？
It doesn't look like it though.
I don't. I'm itching to kiss you quickly.
Good morning. Summer classes start today, don't push yourself too hard？
Jeez. Maybe you can... a little.
Morning! Summer classes start today, I'm going to be strict, okay？
Hehe, just joking. Make sure you do it properly even when I'm not looking, okay？
Morning. Let's do our best in summer classes starting today, okay？
Jeez, there's no point telling me that. But if you get tired, I'll let you lean on me.
Good morning. How are the summer classes？
Hehe, that's true. But do your best. I'll cheer for you.
Morning! Aren't you tired from summer classes？
You have to service me too, so you can't be exhausted, okay？
Yeah, I can't focus on studying.
Jeez, I want to indulge you but... endure it a little？
Good morning. Winter classes are starting, but be careful of the cold, okay？
Even if I'm careful, it's cold...
I'll hug you tight. Forgive me with that？
Morning! Winter classes are starting, but don't lose to the cold, okay？
I'm enduring it. Because I'm the older sister, right？ Hehe.
Morning. Winter classes are starting. Are you feeling okay？
If it gets tough, I'll take them for you. Just kidding？
Good morning. Haven't caught a cold？
If you feel sick, tell me right away. You're my important person, after all.
Morning! Got used to the cold？
A little. But it's still cold.
If you say too many pathetic things, I'll punish you, you know？ Hehe, do your best!
Morning. It's cold today too. Can I stick close to you？
Hehe, good that you're honest. Then I won't hold back.
Good morning. Spring classes are starting. If you space out, it'll be over in a flash, you know？
It'd be nice and easy if it ended in a flash.
Jeez. Hehe, but I'm the same.
Morning! Spring classes start today. I'll punish you every time you doze off, okay？
Morning. Spring classes are starting, but if you focus it'll end quickly, you know？
I wonder if I can... concentrate？
You'll be fine. Do your best.
Good morning. Spring classes, aren't you sleepy？
Hehe, me too. But just a little more, let's do our best together？
Morning! Spring classes, are you studying properly？
Ah, you're energetic. Then maybe I'll ask you to do mine too？
Morning. Spring is sleepy after all. Are you okay？
Hehe, you're not okay. Please, cheer up？
Come to think of it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Did you hear about the contest？
Jeez... it's always stuff like that.
It seems to be a hot topic. In some parts.
Are you included in those parts？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ might be chosen, so I'm a bit curious.
Is that something I should be happy about.
...Well, as your boyfriend I have mixed feelings.
If it was decided without asking, there's no way to decline.
It's complicated but... I'm still happy. It means my girlfriend is attractive.
Even if you weren't chosen for this, you're an attractive girlfriend though.
Hehe, jeez. To me, those words make me happier.
